Capture a schema asserted to be public

Source: R/config.R
pmx_schema.Rd

This helper records names and practical classes only. Calling it is an assertion that those metadata and factor/category levels are public; do not derive them from confidential data unless their release has been approved.

Usage

pmx_schema(data, exclude = NULL)

Arguments

data

A public schema template.

exclude

Columns omitted from generated output.

Value

A pmx_schema object.
